sn4.3:1.4: Māra appears like the godlings of Susīma’s assembly ([sn2.29:10.2]()). It is not easy to know what gods to trust.
sn4.3:3.4: _Paddhagū_ seems to be _pa_ + _addha_ + _gū_ (or _cara_ at [sn6.4:10.1]()), “one who travels in front”. They serve kings ([thag13.1:1.2]()). The use of this term here suggests that they will not make Māra’s job easier for him by smoothing his path.
